coverage: 24 Chrome comparisons: check/report, form/control, cancellation and later-control repair/disable/removal/reassociation.
External form owners and document order; novalidate ignored for explicit checks; no form submission.
Standalone control reporting focus and canceled-report focus preservation.
Godot Save-button calls drain invalid events after the current callback without recursive pumping.
Explicit errors on unsupported patterns, nested invalid-handler requests, unknown targets and queue overflow; no partial invalid events on preflight failure.
remaining: Nested invalid-handler validation is explicitly unsupported.
Normal Godot handler calls defer invalid handlers to the current outer event drain rather than browser-style recursive dispatch.
Reporting supplies focus and handler hooks, not built-in localized validation bubbles.
Unicode-v patterns, validity selectors and broader controls remain incomplete.
The72 timing gates cover ordinary sample workloads, not the cost of the new explicit validation methods or total UI/GPU cost.
